result.rationale: The diff adds `before_validation do self.host.sub!(...) end` in embeddable_host.rb with no nil guard, and the controller's `save_host` assigns `host.host = params[:embeddable_host][:host]` which can be nil. `sub!` on nil raises NoMethodError before `validates_format_of` runs, so a create/update without a host param yields a 500 instead of a validation error. Mechanism is verifiable from the diff; impact limited to admin API.

judged_text: app/models/embeddable_host.rb:6 — `before_validation { self.host.sub!(...) }` calls `sub!` on `nil` when `host` is absent, so `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#create` with a payload lacking `embeddable_host[host]` (or `params[:embeddable_host]` missing entirely, which already NoMethodErrors at embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:23 on `nil[:host]`) returns a 500 instead of the 422 that `validates_format_of` was meant to produce (severity P2, confidence 75, advisory; rebuttal: the Ember UI disables save on an empty host via `cantSave`, but the admin API is reachable by any staff client)
